exercise: Publish SO1001 to a topic subscribed by q.orders; consume with QoS 1, then acknowledge.
expected: One matching event is consumed; the acknowledged event is removed.
verification: HTTP client contract tests only; no SAP broker available

exercise: Create q.billing and q.shipping with the same topic subscription; publish one event.
expected: Each queue receives its own copy; acknowledging one does not remove the other.
verification: HTTP client contract tests only; no SAP broker available

exercise: Run two consumers against one queue and publish ten distinct events.
expected: Ten unique IDs processed in total; distribution between consumers is not guaranteed equal.
verification: HTTP client contract tests only; no SAP broker available

exercise: Publish while the consumer is stopped, then reconnect. Re-publish the same application event ID.
expected: Durable queue retains the offline message; consumer deduplicates using event ID. Transport acknowledgement alone does not make business processing exactly-once.
verification: HTTP client contract tests only; no SAP broker available

exercise: Configure the product-supported retry/redelivery and dead-letter settings; force a handler failure.
expected: Record actual retry count and dead-letter result. Do not assume another broker’s failure semantics.
verification: HTTP client contract tests only; no SAP broker available
